_comment: Issue #1765, re-judged for #1949: a cavalry troop that breaks from a contagion flees and rallies without its men riding through each other, and re-forms where they come to rest. Player Cavalry (uid 0, 18 horses on 5 files: 3 full ranks and a 3-horse short rank) starts facing south at (700, 500) and is quarter-turned right (E) at tick 12, so it faces west. A weak Infantry company (uid 1, 8 men) stands south of it. The enemy Cavalry (uid 2) charges the company, which breaks at tick 169; the contagion (12 morale off every friend within 140 wu) breaks the troop too, and uid 0 reads ROUTING from tick 170. Each routed man runs north on his own (SoldierFlightStep), the troop rallies at tick 531 near the field's north edge, its men pull up on their own at their braking rate, and it re-forms where they come to rest: its grid is laid out at their centroid and each man is dealt the place nearest where he stands. Measured with dense 2-tick FULL dumps on seeds 0 to 4, 2026-11-20 on #1949's branch: no two of the troop's men stand within a body radius of each other at the break (ticks 170 and 172), at the rally (tick 531), or while they pull up and re-form (tick 700) (pairs_within_body_radius 0, pinned). From tick 760 on seeds 1 to 3 the troop, far from any enemy, drops to the far tier, which has no bodies to read, so no later tick is pinned. #1765's pins read the slot grid: slots_across_centreline 0 and slot_lateral_excess 0 (tol 0.5 or 1.0 wu) at ticks 170, 172, 531, 864 and 1080, claiming that the rout moved no slot and that the rally re-squared the fold in depth only. The bottom-up flight (#1949) removed the slot a routed man would keep and the fold and re-square the rally undid, so those eight pins are retired for the pairs_within_body_radius pins, which fail for a flight or a re-form that sends men through each other. The follow_error exemption for uids 0 and 2 is dropped: on seeds 0 to 4 uid 0 reads under 0.001 wu now that the scan no longer judges a rallied unit's shape while its men pull up from their flight, and uid 2, the enemy cavalry, is exempted below with its readings: its riders, ordered to attack the company, ride the company's runners down rider by rider (SoldierTakeUp). The clip ends at tick 1100.

follow_error.reason: This is a regression from the riders' own pursuit (#1949), measured 2026-11-20: the enemy cavalry (uid 2) reads 79.13, 110.93, 98.62, 102.30 and 97.36 on seeds 0 to 4 against 30 (main 6d65b227: 37.74, 54.08, 36.59, 47.00 and 50.97, under its own exemption). Riders who stop riding while others of the troop still ride ride back to their places on a grid laid where the troop's riders were when every one of them rode (couple reads a troop off its men then), hundreds of wu off, and the shape is read off them (the chasers are left out, DemoChasers). A unit that falls in on its own men rather than on a laid grid is #1954.

overlap.reason: This is a regression from the riders' own pursuit (#1949), measured 2026-11-20: the enemy cavalry (uid 2) reads 7.27, 3.55, 4.29, 7.63 and 7.77 on seeds 0 to 4 against 5, failing on seeds 1 and 2 (main 6d65b227: 15.28, 15.76, 17.36, 15.02 and 11.58): riders riding runners down cross riders riding back to their places. A rider who gives way to a crossing rider before contact is #1956.
